# MLST development baseline

`expected.json` holds the frozen comparator calls and importer records for the 52 valid synthetic fixtures of the MLST feasibility study (issue #2). The fixtures contain no study genomes. They are generated by `investigations/mlst/harness/make_fixtures.py` with seed 20261009 from the historical scheme package. Neither the fixtures nor the scheme package are committed here.

For each fixture the file records:

- the fixture's SHA-256;
- `mlst` 2.32.2 with BLAST+ 2.16.0 allele tokens, ST, STATUS and SCORE, taken from the saved comparator output;
- the frozen supplementary-MLST importer's state, ST, profile-compatible candidate ST and copy-diagnostic reasons, taken from `investigations/mlst/results/importer-diagnostic.tsv`;
- the comparator's exact locations: hits with identical bases over at least half the allele, full length and no mismatch.

| Input | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| Saved comparator runs archive | `997db572f267182c6760672d80cce0a3085ea1f78618ad7063d94f009cb4b18f` |
| Fixture manifest from the feasibility run | `943ccfd041ca6c2cd62d41e97a2d68eccf4a3a02c8b58b7718bca765a8f85433` |
| `investigations/mlst/results/importer-diagnostic.tsv` | `82b24f6bf136b190de9d27ef1cd2a21de777da1965d6a4a4cacc25be040470be` |
| Scheme package `manifest.json`, package `enterobacter-pubmlst-pre2025-retrieved-20261006` | `0f0a4bd051e7a29d97f530a38982026df10ca223805e7b0147b19796763978dd` |
| `expected.json` | `3c7d7595960d4a4ae2794ba1128a0e7c41727226d3fb2e43d684c4c5b9ccbfb0` |

`tests/mlst_dev_baseline.rs` types every fixture with `terobacter-ungapped-mlst` and compares tokens, ST, STATUS, SCORE, state, candidate ST, copy reasons and exact locations. It is ignored by default; its header shows how to run it. The derivation script, commands and receipts are kept in the research run.

This is development parity on designed fixtures, with engine constants fitted on the same fixtures. Returned-state, ST, candidate-ST and cutoff parity on real assemblies is RG-4 in mbhall88/Enterobacter#25.
